programme.title: Bang Bang You're Dead
programme.desc: A group of six travelers hop on the bus from Casablanca airport headed to Marrakesh. Among them, someone has $2 million intended for a local operator to influence United Nations votes. But who's the person? AKA Our Man in Marrakesh

programme.title: The Cat and the Canary
programme.desc: A group of potential heirs gather in a forbidding old house to learn which of them will inherit a fortune. Later, they learn that a flesh-rending maniac is loose.

programme.title: The Hit
programme.desc: Ten years after Willie Parker snitched on his mob buddies for his own protection, a couple of hitmen kidnap him and take him to Paris where they plan to execute him. But along the journey, they run into all sorts of problems.

programme.title: No Man of God
programme.desc: The complex relationship that developed between FBI analyst Bill Hagmaier and serial killer Ted Bundy during Bundy's last years on death row.

programme.title: Hooligan Legacy
programme.desc: Relentless. Gritty. Brutal. A visceral story of football, betrayal and revenge. Four men execute a daring football stadium robbery, but the volatile dynamic soon turns sour, landing the villainous leader of the pack in jail. Now he is back on the streets and will stop at nothing to take his revenge.

programme.title: A Romance Wedding
programme.desc: Zoe Davis is a successful and highly driven wedding planner in the big city. When her father asks her for help at the family café shop, she happily drives back to her cozy hometown of Romance, Oregon. Little does she know her mom has already hired Will to help, an aspiring chef and coincidentally...Zoe’s childhood sweetheart! Tensions rise between Zoe and Will, but so does the chemistry. Will they settle their differences and find lost love along the way?

programme.title: The Dating List
programme.desc: Abby Morel is a bright, young editor’s assistant living in the big city. Wanting to get ahead in her career, she makes an unusual deal with her high-flying boss, Susan. Susan is far too busy to date, but she wants to fall in love. Abby agrees to ‘screen’ dates in exchange for a promotion, and to add to the pressure, Susan is looking for the perfect man! After a couple of disasters, Abby meets Dan, who seemingly ticks all the boxes. The trouble is, she’s starting to fall for him too… A promising career now within her reach, will she risk losing it all for true love?

programme.title: Cooking Up Love
programme.desc: On a lark, Zoey rents a food truck and enters a reality TV competition. Heat rises between her and the handsome founder of a fast food chain, but when Zoey finds out he’s a judge in the contest, things quickly fizzle. Zoey’s determined to win fair and square and she suspects Mr-Too-Good-To-Be-True is really after her sauce recipe, not her heart.

programme.title: Champagne Charlie
programme.desc: This is the tale of Charles Heidsieck who introduced Champagne to the American market right before the Civil War. Though a hesitant French spy, he ends up caught and held in a Union prison. The story also features two love stories (since, well, he's French) and some conflicts with his uncle over who gets to run the family vineyard. The tension comes from the fact that his dad married his mom, who was also his uncle's love interest.

programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: In 1879 South Africa, British Cape Colony administrators seek to crush the Zulus, viewing them as an obstacle to their colonial ambitions. To provoke war, they issue King Cetshwayo an impossible ultimatum, confident their rifles and artillery will ensure an easy victory. But as Lord Chelmsford’s forces chase an unseen foe, they discover near Isandlwana how gravely they’ve underestimated the Zulu nation’s skill and strength.

programme.title: The Perfect Cheerleader
programme.desc: When Cassie Talbot gets into the college of her dreams and makes the cheerleading squad, she feels her whole world is changing, for the better! She has new friends, cheerleading is exciting, things are good... But when a handsome man comes into her life, she slowly uncovers a dark secret. And when a fellow cheerleader disappears, and is found dead under suspicious circumstances, it unlocks a deadly conspiracy, putting her life in grave danger

programme.title: Cheer for your Life
programme.desc: A high school girl feels defeated during a rough Cheerleader Initiation Week, but her dreams aren’t the only thing at stake when another cheerleader ends up dead.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Three decades after WWII ended, a group of ex-GIs and German soldiers are aiming to recover Nazi treasure stashed away in the Soviet-controlled part of East Germany. Only a Nazi war criminal, who is behind bars, knows the precise spot where it's hidden.
